name: Lineage Desk
tagline: Family history with analyst's discipline: free sources first, each one graded for trust
description: It works your family questions the way an analyst works a case, starting from free public records before anything paid is suggested. Every source gets a reliability grade, and a documented link is kept apart from family lore that still needs proof. You get a file you can defend, not a tree of wishful connections.
